q: It's better to provide an illustration of question 3: "an object is put on a box instead of in it".
reply: **Done.** Prediction 3 now tells the whole John-and-the-cat story (Kosinski's version, quoted by Ullman, p. 6) and has a two-panel picture: the cat **in** the box (hidden, so John has a false belief) versus **on** the box (visible, so he should know).
